name: line-chart
title: LineChart
description: Dates use milliseconds or parseable strings; plotting is chronological and raw rows remain unchanged. Missing and non-finite values remain gaps. Defaults: 40px margin, 2 / 1 aspect ratio, 1100ms entrance, curveNatural, 2.5px stroke, edge fading on. Loading/reveal and 500ms Y-domain tween reuse AreaChart. Brush uses Date start/end, neutral inactive ranges and a full track border.
